name: iteration8_shared_schur_native_forest
seed_rule: base_seed + 1000 * modes; three profiles share the same U
precision_policy: one true long-double batch; on eligible numerical guard failure one entire-prefix __float128 refinement; same fixed R/E; quad state originates from binary64 V in quad and reuses only its own canonical zero-prefix states
primary_law_backend: native executable; failure mass retained; no sample generation before enumeration
python_crosscheck: all 72 complete extended native laws against Python interface/reference; shared batched event kernel for forest so this is orchestration, not independent event-arithmetic validation
table_crosscheck: all 24 new forest laws at m8; independent complete-target event sums using native traced R/E; separately check traced R/E against Python selector/tree
failure_policy: No retry or success renormalization. Numerical failure at an enumerated reachable prefix adds its full path mass to failure. A baseline process that cannot enumerate is explicitly unavailable, not replaced by a successful-path law. Sampling stops on first failure, preserving completed count and payload.
quality_comparison: chain/tree k2 vs retained k4; chain/tree k4 vs retained k6; all pairwise values retained

timing.summary_statistic: median of three cold batches per fixed case/method/N; report min/max as well; compare matched medians and summarize the six profile-by-N ratios by their median
timing.sample_seed_rule: base + repetition; same seed per method, no promise of paired sample paths
timing.primary_cost: native cold_batch = setup + sampling, including physicality/setup/static MI, selector, tree, all failed long-double attempts, quad refinement, state reconstruction/updates, RNG and sample allocation
timing.secondary_cost: wrapper wall seconds and input/aggregation time retained separately
timing.comparison: full native forest vs full native retained-click at the matched quality case; no Python-vs-C++ speed claims
timing.pareto_rule: new complete TV <= matched baseline TV + 1e-10 and median cold batch time strictly smaller; no missing/failed repetitions permitted
timing.failed_run_policy: record all failures; do not compute a completed-batch throughput for incomplete runs or replace them

historical_numerical_regression.scope: historical regression, never merged into fresh quality or timing panel; compare extended law/failure to archived round7 and table reference

claim_scope: Fixed synthetic small-system floating-point laws and this host's full native batch costs. Heuristic roundoff propagation is not an interval certificate. No universal TV guarantee, novelty claim, exact-GBS asymptotic improvement, Jiuzhang comparison, or classical-limit breakthrough is inferred.
continuation_rule: If both quality-cost usefulness and numerical reliability fail, begin a different exploration without waiting for permission. Record partial gains as partial; do not turn engineering reliability into a sampling-complexity theorem.
